content:
oncall-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx observed for tenant 'orchid-therapeutics' in dedicated pool orchid-dedicated-us-west-2a canary. Around 12% 5xx over the last 10m, latency spikes. Pinned artifact: inference-service:v2.1.3. Paging on-call.
Sam Reynolds: I'm on it. seeing same in metrics dashboard. Canary has ~3% of traffic for the tenant. Any recent config changes? @deploy-bot what was deployed and when?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: user-triggered artifact pin -> inference-service:v2.1.3 deployed to orchid-canary group at 2026-03-10T14:00:12Z. Health checks initially OK, 15m rolling window. No autoscaler changes recorded. Logs attached to deployment job: "deploy-orchid-17684".
Mira Desai: Checking pod logs now. Seeing repeated exceptions in model loader: "Err: incompatible KV cache layout after quantize" followed by OOM-like GC spikes. Will paste snippets.
Mira Desai: ```
2026-03-10T14:04:45Z inference-service[orchid-canary-3] ERROR ModelLoader: failed to map kv-cache, fallback failed
2026-03-10T14:04:46Z inference-service[orchid-canary-3] WARN OutOfMemoryError: failed allocate 128MB
2026-03-10T14:05:01Z inference-service[orchid-canary-2] ERROR RequestHandler: unhandled exception: model mismatch
```
Leo Tang: That error matches a build-time change in the runtime kernels for v2.1.3 that we gated behind a canary flag. Looks like this customer's pinned artifact ended up in a canary slice that didn't get the backwards-compatible kernel. The artifact expects KVC format 2.3, the runtime is 2.2 on some nodes.
Sam Reynolds: Customer impact: Jordan, any reports from Orchid? Jordan (CSM):
Jordan (CSM): I just got a message from their infra lead — about 20% of their inference calls are failing with 500s, primarily batch inference and a couple of critical webhooks. They want immediate rollback if we can do it safely. SLA exposure: potential latency/availability breach if >30m.
Avery Kline: Quick mitigation options: 1) revert canary artifact to v2.1.2 for the orchid shard, 2) route orchid traffic to standby dedicated pool if available, 3) patch runtime kernel on canary nodes (higher risk/time). Prefer rollback.
Sam Reynolds: Agreed. Rollback plan: pin orchid tenant to inference-service:v2.1.2 and remove v2.1.3 from the canary slice for that tenant. Execute canary revert for tenant only. I'll coordinate with infra.
Leo Tang: Commands to run (run from ops-admin):

```bash
# restrict new canary traffic for orchid
redwoodctl routing set-tenant-rule --tenant orchid-therapeutics --pool orchid-dedicated-us-west-2a --traffic 0 --reason "emergency rollback"

# pin artifact rollback
redwoodctl artifact pin --tenant orchid-therapeutics --artifact inference-service:v2.1.2 --scope tenant

# trigger a controlled rollout
redwoodctl rollout start --tenant orchid-therapeutics --artifact inference-service:v2.1.2 --strategy tenant-only --grace 30s
```
Mira Desai: Starting the routing change now. I'll gate on health checks once v2.1.2 pods are up.
deploy-bot: Action scheduled: routing change by Mira Desai at 2026-03-10T14:22:10Z. Rollout job created: rollback-orchid-17684.
Sam Reynolds: Jordan, please inform the customer we are reverting to a known-good artifact (v2.1.2) and expect reduced errors within ~5-10 minutes after pods become healthy. We'll follow up with RCA.
Jordan (CSM): On it. I'll tell them we expect recovery within 15m and will escalate if they see anything after that.
Mira Desai: v2.1.2 pods are starting. health checks are green for 2 instances so far. Monitoring shows 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 4% in last 2m.
Sam Reynolds: Nice. Keep an eye on tail latency and any auth-related failures — sometimes pinning changes headers.
Avery Kline: After rollback, we should schedule a targeted canary that forces the kernel compatibility checks and add a preflight job that validates KV cache layout for pinned artifacts. Filing follow-up tickets.
Leo Tang: Creating infra ticket: INFRA-ORCHID-296 "ensure kernel/kvcache compatibility check in artifact onboarding". Also recommend flagging v2.1.3 as blocked for any auto-pinning until we reconcile kernels.
Mira Desai: 5xx now at 0.9%, within acceptable range. Rolling monitoring to steady state.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed: rollback-orchid-17684 at 2026-03-10T14:38:06Z. Observability: errors returned to baseline.
Sam Reynolds: I'm going offline to log the incident and hand off to daytime on-call. @Avery Kline will monitor for the next 2 hours. Filing incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps.
Avery Kline: Monitoring. If error rate creeps >2% again, I'll re-open paging. Also will coordinate with Release and Model Ops to re-evaluate v2.1.3 onboarding.
Jordan (CSM): Customer confirmed degraded window was ~18m and now stable. They want a postmortem and assurance before we attempt v2.1.3 again. I'll collect their logs and coordinate.
Sam Reynolds: Thanks team. Incident closed for now — will capture action items: block v2.1.3 for auto-rollout, add kv-cache preflight, customer follow-up. :white_check_mark:
